d: Indonesia is facing a devastating wildfire and air pollution crisis. A new report by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) estimates that toxic smoke from forest and land fires caused 3,560 deaths in September 2026 alone. Nearly 58 million people were exposed to unhealthy or hazardous air quality levels. The overall estimated air-pollution-related death toll reached 5,310, including deaths linked to industrial emissions, vehicle pollution and other non-fire sources. From Kalimantan and Sumatra to Java, millions are facing the consequences of deteriorating air quality.…
